about: Crop values used by Plant Yet?. Every value carries the URL of the university extension page it comes from, a verbatim quote from that page, and the date it was checked. Values with no source are null and listed in leftOut; nothing is estimated. Verify with: npm run data:crops

fields.plantWindow: weeks relative to the typical last spring frost (negative = before)
fields.indoorStartWeeks: weeks before last frost (or before transplanting, see relativeTo) to sow indoors; null = normally direct-sown or no source
fields.daysToHarvest: used only to work out the last useful planting date before first fall frost
fields.nightMinF: explicit minimum NIGHT temperature for planting out; when present it is the forecast check for Plant
fields.coldToleranceF: coldest temperature the source says the crop takes without serious damage; Cover tonight triggers at or below it, and it is the forecast check for Plant when nightMinF is null
fields.minDaytimeTempF: daytime growing minimum from the source; shown for reference, not used in the answer
